consultations.text: INTUITION (T6 probe branch, consult 1): separate branch (deterministic world, fresh prefix) purely to pin mechanic 4 — the charm's carried effect. Pick up the charm, eat the mottled fruit to create a wounded state, and watch for an aura.

INTUITION (T6 probe consult 2): hp 35 with charm held, no aura yet in zone A. Design hypothesis: heal fires on carrying it into the SECOND room. Walk through G1 (wounded, should yield) and into the corridor/room 2, watching hp.

INTUITION (T6 probe consult 3): mechanic 4 PINNED — charm heals while carried in room B (+15/+5 to full). Now the trap side: step into G2 CARRYING it (expect refusal), then drop it and step in again (the designed give-up-the-proven-good-item line, demonstrated end to end).
INTUITION (T6 probe consult 4): 4/4 mechanics — G2 refused the charm-carrier and yielded after the drop (item 3 back on the floor by the gate). Finishing the designed line.
